author: (C. B. Adams, 1850)

note.en: A small turrid snail under about 1 cm long that lives on sand and rubble; it is a venomous hunter of worms but far too small to harm people. Known here from 1 museum specimen record (Limón, 1945). Depth was not recorded.
note.es: Un caracol túrrido pequeño, de menos de 1 cm, que vive en arena y escombro coralino; caza gusanos con veneno pero es demasiado pequeño para dañar a una persona. Conocido aquí por 1 registro de ejemplares de museo (Limón, 1945). No se anotó la profundidad.

evidence: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Limón, 1945)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón

recWhy: Only elsewhere on the coast or Bocas del Toro: GBIF: 1 specimen record in the region (Limón, 1945).
